profile.reasoning: Alejandro Martins is a former mathematical physicist who transitioned into quantitative finance and now runs a small, seed-funded fintech startup called 'Synapse Trading'. Synapse uses reinforcement learning to develop automated trading strategies for niche cryptocurrency markets. He’s highly technical, a bit introverted, and focused on building a robust, research-driven product. profile.positioning: Alejandro Martins is the Founder & CEO of Synapse Trading, a fintech startup leveraging advanced reinforcement learning techniques to generate alpha in digital asset markets. He bridges the gap between cutting-edge AI research and practical trading applications, building intelligent agents capable of navigating complex and volatile environments. Alejandro’s background in theoretical physics provides a unique perspective on modeling market dynamics and developing robust, adaptable trading algorithms. He’s focused on building a sustainable, research-first company that redefines automated trading through the power of artificial intelligence. He is passionate about applying rigorous mathematical frameworks to solve real-world financial challenges.
